data: Microsoft reported total revenue of about $211.9 billion in fiscal 2023, which ended June 30, 2023, and about $281.7 billion in fiscal 2025, which ended June 30, 2025. That is an increase of roughly $69.8 billion, or about 32.9% over the two years. The growth came in two steps: revenue rose to about $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024, up roughly 15.7%, and then grew about 14.9% in fiscal 2025. Most of the gain came from the Intelligent Cloud segment, particularly Azure, along with growth in Microsoft 365 commercial. These figures are from Microsoft's annual reports, and you should check them against the 10-K filings if you need exact precision.
